fontLicensePolicy: The existing renamed Source Sans 3 Regular instance is reused unchanged with source and OFL notice retained. The same static font, optical design and weight400 are used in both variants.
mode: Existing generated photographic artwork and paper presentation reused unchanged; exact-font native SVG positioning. Insets repeat complete artifact content with matched crop/scale and explanatory guides. No new image generation.

layout_record.method: Exact fixed-font metrics supply starting offsets; editorial review judges visible relationships. Only one declared translation changes per artifact. Detail viewports repeat the same artifact with identical crop/scale and explanatory guides.

comparisonPolicy: Only one declared transform changes in each artifact: first quote line −18.744 on x; complete headline +9.462 on x; OPEN +6.12 on y. The latter starts from the measured lowercase-x height reference and moves to measured visible-capital centering, subject to editorial review. No glyph editing, internal kerning/tracking, font/size/weight, copy, line-break, imagery/crop, frame or other position changes. Close-up overlays are explanatory only and identical across comparison variants.

verification.textBounds: within the declared paper or phone surface
verification.pixelCheck: Only intended declared optical-alignment intervention regions differ.

limitations: Static English-language editorial specimens; no universal nudge values, empirically established perceptual centers, reader-performance study, physical print trial, implemented responsive behavior or full accessibility evaluation. The before designs remain legible and may suit other purposes.
